root.label: ALMA Cycle 13 begins with Band 2 receivers

events.label: ALMA Cycle 13 begins with Band 2 receivers

slots.name: receiver bands
slots.sentence: According to ALMA, the new equipment completes the 10 receiver bands originally planned for the observatory.

slots.name: antenna count
slots.sentence: Situated on the Chajnantor Plateau in Chile's Atacama Desert, ALMA uses more than 50 antennas working together to detect radiation at millimeter and submillimeter wavelengths.

slots.name: observing allocation
slots.sentence: U.S.-based researchers will help lead major projects during Cycle 13. North American teams received approximately 34% of the available observing time, Carpenter said.

slots.name: proposal count
slots.sentence: Astronomers submitted a record 1,839 proposals for Cycle 13, requesting 37,471 hours of observation time on the 12-meter array, or 8.7 times the time initially available.

slots.name: observation hours
slots.sentence: Their 89 approved high-priority proposals account for about 1,400 hours of observations using ALMA's 12-meter antenna array.
